VERIFIED_POSITIVES: Bootstrap STOP now mandates stable legacy-admission freeze and deterministic reconciliation of discovered legacy mutation/integration authority before a successful terminal stop proof.
Mission STOP now creates immutable intent before entry CAS and binds ACTIVE_TRANSITION_ID, ACTIVE_TRANSITION_INTENT_HASH, ACTIVE_TRANSITION_STATE and TRANSITION_GENERATION in the STOP CAS.
Preempted transition identity is preserved separately rather than erased.
ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH are incremented at Mission STOP entry so pre-stop leases/memberships and queued not-yet-active integration intents become stale.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION and ambiguous Git truth remain durable and are reconciled rather than cleared.
Repeated USER_STOP behavior is idempotent and does not reopen gates.

REMAINING_BLOCKERS.FACT: V2 PRE_MISSION_FENCE_STOP.TERMINAL_PROOF uses STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED as a Bootstrap terminal state, but clause [049] enumerates Bootstrap states and includes STOPPED but not STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
REMAINING_BLOCKERS.LAW_TENSION: Clause [168] requires STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED for ambiguous external state, but the pre-genesis Bootstrap state domain does not define that literal value.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Do not write an undefined Bootstrap STATE value.

Define an authority-preserving pre-genesis representation consistent with both [049] and [168], e.g. retain STATE=STOPPING or another existing fail-closed Bootstrap state while binding a separate canonical STOP_OUTCOME=STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, or establish an authoritative schema extension before use.
Specify exactly when Bootstrap STATE may become STOPPED and ensure it cannot imply reconciliation success while ambiguity remains.

REMAINING_BLOCKERS.FACT: COMMON_STOP_INTENT lists Mission-only observed transition/epoch/integration fields as immutable fields even for Bootstrap pre-genesis STOP, but V2 does not define JSON types or whether unavailable values are null, omitted, or another sentinel.
REMAINING_BLOCKERS.IMPACT: Two compliant writers can materialize different JCS objects and STOP_INTENT_HASH values for the same observed Bootstrap state.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact JSON types for every STOP intent field.
Require all listed fields to be present and use JSON null for not-applicable/unavailable values, or define a different single canonical encoding.
Define array/object ordering and empty-value rules for any nested stop evidence fields.

PHYSICAL_WRITE_BOUNDARY: Canonical authority invalidation is distinguishable from sink-level prevention of stale physical Git writes; V2's stated stronger-guarantee boundary remains acceptable.
